China offers visa facilitation to Indian business travelers

China has stated its readiness to collaborate with India on facilitating visa arrangements for business travelers. This offer comes in response to reports indicating a reduction in visa issuances to Indian nationals, which has affected their participation in an Expo held in Shanghai. The visa application procedures have reportedly been moved to direct handling by diplomatic missions.
